kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - The new vents stagnated last night, there is currently no active lava on the ground. The north, south, and west vents continue to glow. A minor summit deflation began at about 5 pm HST last night. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
